page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; page number top right; marginal notes in the left and right margins, several of them set in italic and partly illegible from the scan.

main_text.head: CAPUT V. DE M. AURELIO COMMODO ANTONINO.
main_text.p: Annus fuit 182, mense s. dieti 18, ad A.C. 193.
Commodi Imperium Pertinacem ... ficut exitus rerum Ecclesia ... Pertinax. ... Pertinax ... Lucilla ... Herodianus. ... Aufidius ... Quadratilla...

[illegible, ~40 letters] ... Alter ... quem ille ... Sub hoc ... Cleander vero totum ... Commodi thermae. ... Commodi thermas, in quibus ... Orta ... Herodianus ... plebs ad necem ... Terruit ... Pompeianus ... Lucilla ... exequo ... Vitae

page.notes: Most of the page is faded and smudged; the marginal notes and much of the running text are only partly legible, so the transcription above is incomplete and approximate. Words marked as illegible or uncertain could not be read reliably. Italic words in the margins are doubtful.
